description: NaVTeO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.86 Å. V is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.85 Å. Te is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.14 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one V and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom.
